target_customer: Developers and SaaS companies wanting self-hostable customer messaging automation
problem: Marketing automation platforms like Klaviyo and Customer.io are costly and closed.
business_model: Open-source (MIT) core with paid cloud and Embedded Components

founders.name: Chandler Craig
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: startup marketer, full-stack engineer.

founders.name: Maxwell Gurewitz
founders.background_notes: Led major engineering initiatives at Braze; senior engineer at OpenTable.

exit.reason: Company states it could not make the business sustainable ("we couldn't make it work"); Cloud closed 2026-10-31, code remains open source.

technical_complexity.rationale: Multi-channel messaging orchestration (email, SMS, push, WhatsApp) is standard but broad engineering; founders had Braze experience.

defensibility.rationale: MIT-licensed code is freely copyable and there is no data lock-in evidence; competitors include well-funded Klaviyo and Customer.io.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it in sources; incumbents continued as the market leaders.

market_need_then: Self-hosting and cost interest in open-source Klaviyo/Customer.io alternatives; Product Hunt launches in 2023 and 2025 and about 3,000 GitHub stars by late 2026 show developer interest but not paying demand.
outcome_analysis: Dittofeed, an open-source Klaviyo alternative from a two-person team, wound down in 2026: Cloud closed on 2026-10-31 and the company said it could not make the business sustainable. Open-source adoption (about 3,000 GitHub stars) did not translate into enough paying customers against entrenched, funded incumbents, though the sources do not state the precise cause.
notes: Shutdown comes from dittofeed.com; a web search found no news coverage and YC page text via search said Active (queue status Inactive). An aggregator claims $500K pre-seed, likely YC's standard deal; not recorded as a round. Founding year 2022 (YC) vs 2023 (launch post). Failure factors are inferred from the company's own statement and are tentative.
